sign-in. Priority, status and assignee are for workers to set: a body
that sends them (or any unknown field) is rejected with 422.

get.description:
The case queue. Filters combine; open cases first, then by priority
(critical first), then newest. `q` matches the case number, title,
description or location.

schema.title: Response List Cases V1 Cases Get

post.description: A case a worker opens: a phone call, a walk-in, an incident.

get.description: The latest updates across all cases, newest first.

schema.title: Response Recent Activity V1 Cases Activity Get

get.description: Dashboard numbers, counted from the cases themselves.
A case with its full history and referrals.

patch.description:
Triage and progress: status, priority, category, assignee (null to
unassign) and details. Each change is recorded in the history.

post.description:
A draft update to the requester, for the worker to edit and send (as a
public update). Never sent by itself. 503 when AI isn't configured.

Resources that fit the case, each with a reason, chosen only from the
resource directory. Without AI (`method: rules`), the resources in the
case's category.
A short summary of the case and its history. 503 when AI isn't configured.
Connect the case with a community resource. 409 if it's already on it.

patch.description:
Track a referral: suggested, shared, accepted, completed or declined,
and record its outcome.

post.description:
An internal note (default), or with `visibility: public` a message
the requester sees on their request.

get.description: Liveness only: no database round-trip and no deployment metadata.

schema.title: Response Health Check V1 Health Get

get.description: The signed-in user; the first call provisions them.

patch.description:
Sets the caller's display name and/or IANA timezone. The app sends the
name from the ID token after sign-in, since access tokens don't carry it.
An email address is never kept as a name.

get.description: The caller's own requests, newest first.

schema.title: Response List My Requests V1 Requests Get

post.description:
Ask ComForce MKE for help. The request becomes a case in the worker
queue with status new. Leave `category` out to have it sorted
automatically (when AI routing is configured; otherwise it is `other`).

get.description:
One of the caller's requests, with its public updates (status changes
and messages from ComForce). 404 for anyone else's.

Active resources, real ones before samples. `q` matches the name,
description or neighborhood. Rows with `is_sample: true` are
demonstration data, not real services.

schema.title: Response List Resources V1 Resources Get

post.description: Add a resource to the directory. Staff only.

Picks the ComForce MKE service for a free-text request for help.
Signed-in callers only, so the OpenAI key can't be spent by anyone.

Makes the caller the first staff admin. Works only while nobody is
staff yet (409 after that); from then on admins add workers.

get.description: The caller's role, so the app knows whether to open the worker portal.
Everyone who has signed in, staff first. Admins only.

schema.title: Response List Users V1 Staff Users Get

put.description:
Make someone a worker or admin, or back to a member. Admins only, and
not for their own role.

get.description: Everyone a case can be assigned to, with their open case counts.

schema.title: Response List Workers V1 Staff Workers Get
